name: Western Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Our advanced technology ensures precise and consistent results for both custom fabrication and standard fittings to deliver top-quality sheet metal products. Trust our cutting-edge equipment for superior HVAC or manufacturing solutions.
about:
Western Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1968 in Salt Lake City, Utah, and has operated continuously as a full-service metal fabrication shop serving the HVAC and manufacturing sectors. The company celebrated over 58 years in business as of its most recent marketing materials.

The shop provides custom fabrication, laser cutting, bending, welding, and CAD design services, producing rectangular, spiral, and oval ductwork as well as custom parts for commercial HVAC systems. Its capabilities cover the full fabrication cycle from design to finished fittings, supported by advanced cutting and forming equipment.

Western Sheet Metal serves commercial HVAC contractors, construction firms, and automotive panel manufacturers. Long‑term customers include Okland Construction, J&S Mechanical, and the SMWIA Local 312 union, which supplies the shop’s workforce and underscores its ties to the local trade community.

The company emphasizes its union‑trained workforce, adherence to SMACNA standards, locally sourced materials, and competitive pricing as key differentiators built over more than five decades in the HVAC industry.
